set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- PGP secret material and passphrase are installed only in the approved owner-controlled secret store.
- Central Portal credentials are configured with least privilege.
- A nonrelease dry run validates secret names and ci-release wiring without publishing 1.0.
- No key, passphrase, token, or credential is written to the repository or tracker.
- The final tag can sign and publish the selected artifact matrix.
- Publication status and Central URLs are verified after release.
set.title: Install owner-controlled signing and Maven Central credentials
